title: Japer Technology Public Fabric
tagline: A living catalog of the public repositories published by Japer Technology.
intro: This site is the GitHub Pages front door for the Japer Technology public repo ecosystem. It is designed to show every public repository while still allowing hand-written summaries for the repos that matter most.

an-overview.summary: This repository powers the public fabric itself and is intended to become the maintained overview of every public Japer Technology repository.

github-minimum-intelligence.summary: A repo-local AI framework that uses GitHub Issues, Git, and GitHub Actions as the conversation, memory, and execution layer.

github-openclaw-intelligence.summary: A GitHub-native intelligence variant built around OpenClaw-oriented workflows.

github-agenticana-intelligence.summary: A GitHub-native intelligence variant oriented around Agenticana workflows and experimentation.

japer-technology.github.io.summary: The main GitHub Pages website for Japer Technology.

developer-japer-io.summary: Developer-facing documentation and platform entry point for the JAPER API and related secure services.

github-fabric.summary: An in-progress repository focused on fabric-style publishing and GitHub-native delivery.
